$comment: What the Make app is made of. scripts/deploy.js builds the app from this plus the files it points at; scripts/smoke-test.js uses it to know what to run. Keep in step with the folders.

app.name: kudosity-messaging-3l8g1e
app.label: Kudosity
app.description: Kudosity is a business platform that helps organisations send SMS, MMS, WhatsApp and RCS messages. Our workflow automation enables businesses to send order updates from e-commerce platforms, automate lead nurture programs, and improve customer engagement.

modules.name: v2SendSms
modules.label: Send an SMS
modules.description: Sends an SMS through the Kudosity V2 API.

modules.name: v2SendMms
modules.label: Send an MMS
modules.description: Sends an MMS with one or more media attachments.

modules.name: v2SendWhatsApp
modules.label: Send a WhatsApp Message
modules.description: Sends a WhatsApp text or approved template message, with optional SMS fallback.

modules.name: v2SendRcs
modules.label: Send an RCS Message
modules.description: Sends an RCS text or media message, with optional SMS fallback.

modules.name: v2MakeApiCall
modules.label: Make an API Call
modules.description: Performs an arbitrary authorized call to the Kudosity V2 API.

modules.name: v1SendSms
modules.label: Send an SMS (V1)
modules.description: Sends an SMS through the Kudosity V1 API.

modules.name: v1GetDeliveryStatus
modules.label: Get Delivery Status (V1)
modules.description: Gets the delivery status of a sent SMS.

modules.name: v1FormatNumber
modules.label: Format a Number (V1)
modules.description: Formats a mobile number to international format.

modules.name: v1GetSenderIds
modules.label: Get Sender IDs (V1)
modules.description: Lists the sender IDs and numbers this account may send from.

modules.name: v1GetAccount
modules.label: Get Account Balance (V1)
modules.description: Gets the account balance and its currency.

modules.name: v1GetNumbers
modules.label: List Virtual Numbers (V1)

modules.name: v1GetReplies
modules.label: List Replies (V1)

modules.name: v1MakeApiCall
modules.label: Make an API Call (V1)
modules.description: Performs an arbitrary authorized call to the Kudosity V1 API.

modules.name: watchEvents
modules.label: Watch Events
modules.description: Triggers on Kudosity V2 events such as inbound SMS, delivery status and opt-outs.

modules.name: watchInboundSms
modules.label: Watch Inbound SMS (V1)
modules.description: Triggers when a virtual number receives an SMS.
